snippet.title: Chrétiens persécutés : ne les oublions pas
snippet.description:
Aujourd’hui encore, des chrétiens sont menacés, emprisonnés ou tués à cause de leur foi. Dans son dernier rapport, l’Aide à l’Église en Détresse alerte : la situation s’est aggravée dans plus de la moitié des 18 pays étudiés.

Derrière ces chiffres, il y a des visages, des familles et des communautés qui continuent de croire malgré la peur. Ne les oublions pas.

🔴 Du 15 au 22 novembre, l’AED organise la Semaine rouge : des églises et des monuments s’illuminent en rouge pour rendre visible la souffrance des chrétiens persécutés et rappeler que la liberté religieuse est un droit pour tous.

Prions pour nos frères et sœurs persécutés, et pour que la paix et la liberté de croire progressent partout dans le monde. 🙏

#chrétien #paix #tolérance #religion #prière

snippet.title: I Tried 5 Famous Foods in Banaras! 🤤
snippet.description:
Banaras has a food culture that’s just as fascinating as the city itself! From traditional breakfast favourites to iconic street food and local specialities, there’s plenty to explore. So I spent a day eating my way through the city to discover some of its most talked about dishes.

The adventure took me through some well known food spots, including Kashi Chaat Bhandar, Ram Bhandar, Deena Chaat and Desi Mandapam. Along the way, I tried everything from tamatar chaat and bedmi kachori to palak patta chaat, Banarasi meetha paan and the traditional baati chokha.

Some dishes were instant favourites, while others weren’t quite what I expected. But that’s the fun of exploring a city’s food scene! Another adventure in our 28 Weeks, 28 States series, discovering India’s incredible regional cuisines, one city at a time.

snippet.description:

Chinese President Xi Jinping opened the highly anticipated trilateral meeting with US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday (November 19), calling on major powers to shoulder their special responsibility for the world. Addressing Trump and Putin, Xi said the world was no longer made up of isolated islands and stressed the importance of cooperation among the three countries.

Recalling the Second World War, Xi said China, Russia and the United States had stood together as the main pillars of the anti-fascist front 80 years ago, fighting to achieve a great victory and defend peace. He urged the leaders to preserve their historical memory and build the future by drawing lessons from the past. Trump and Putin were present as Xi delivered his opening remarks at the high-profile gathering.

The trilateral meeting brings together the leaders of three major global powers on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit. Discussions are expected to cover a range of issues, including trade, technology, Iran, the Russia-Ukraine war and nuclear arms control. The meeting is drawing international attention as Washington, Beijing and Moscow come together for high-level discussions in China.
